summary: Final chemistry readout for Drelvessa Therapeutics SAS on the convergent aminopyridine campaign. It compares late and earlier side-chain installation, documents the delivered analogue set and establishes the route basis for follow-on preparation.

slides.title: DT06: convergent aminopyridine routes
slides.subtitle:
Drelvessa Therapeutics SAS | VD-98-076 | 13 Apr 1999
Dr H. Darwish | Revision C

slides.title: Route gate: delivery complete
bullets: {{PRJ0017:n_compounds}} isolated analogues delivered for matched-pair biology.
Earlier side-chain installation improved recovery and is the preferred sequence for the next analogue set.
Material delivery establishes access to the structures; activity against the stress-response kinase remains for Drelvessa to determine.

slides.title: Route comparison: where to carry the side chain
bullets: Late installation retains a common aminopyridine intermediate until diversification.
It offers a simple branching scheme on the route scout.
Late branch-point recovery was the practical weakness.
bullets_right: Earlier installation introduces the side chain before convergence.
The substituted intermediate travels through the remaining sequence.
Recovered material favoured this sequence for follow-on work.

slides.title: Convergence: preserve the useful common intermediate
bullets: Keep core preparation separate from side-chain variation where substitution permits.
Treat a new side chain as a route risk until its substituted intermediate is isolated.
Record the isolated intermediate on the compound card before advancing the branch.
Do not equate a proposed structure with material in the delivery lot.

slides.title: Recovery across the delivered analogue set
Release context and handover
bullets: Hassan Darwish: route sequence and compound cards.
Clara Fenwick: analytical release and delivery register.
bullets_right: Purity is UV area percent at 254 nm, not weight percent.
Use compound-specific amounts to plan the matched pairs.
The delivery register is not a paired route-comparison experiment.

slides.title: Decision: use earlier installation for the next analogue
bullets: Close VD-98-076 with the delivered set.
Start follow-on route scouts from the earlier side-chain sequence.
Drelvessa Therapeutics SAS to return matched-pair priorities.
Confirm material requirements and route compatibility before committing the next analogue.
slides.notes: The route conclusion concerns isolation and recovery. No biological rank order is implied.
